adjudication_order.frozen_statement: Prove literal7.1 telescoping equality when all played/cumulative/comparator terms are finite. Separately retain finite-algorithm/plus-infinite-comparator one-sided extended branch. When both algorithm/comparator incur+infinity the literal subtraction is undefined: required source-domain correction obligation, not an asserted equality. Identically+infinity objectives do not ensure a finite minimizer value.
adjudication_order.decision: accepted locally with explicit ordinary-arithmetic domain repair
adjudication_order.decision_reason: Five compiled declarations establish the domain and all lawful regimes, together with a both-infinite undefined disposition. Seven concrete models test the boundary cases. Selected-top obstruction uses the order-minimizer interpretation; the finite-selected same-index counterexample is independent of that convention.
adjudication_order.domain: Under the source run premises, the displayed right-hand side is defined exactly when every selected cumulative value through T is finite and played and comparator losses do not both hit +∞. If all used values are finite the real telescoping result applies. With finite selected objectives, played-only +∞ yields +∞ on both sides, comparator-only +∞ yields −∞ on both, and both hitting +∞ makes both sides undefined.

examples.finite_source_model: Both sides equal −2 on a closed nonconvex feasible set with comparator outside V and an unused infinite loss.
examples.lawful_played_top: Played loss +∞ with finite comparator; both sides are +∞.
examples.lawful_comparator_top: Comparator loss +∞ with finite played values; both sides are −∞.
examples.same_index_undefined: Same-round +∞−(+∞), with finite selected minimizer values. This witnesses the source arithmetic defect even when a selected minimizer must have finite value.
examples.different_index_undefined: Two rounds contribute +∞ and −∞ separately. Their sum is undefined.
examples.selected_top_only_rhs_undefined: With an order minimizer of an all-+∞ feasible objective, LHS is +∞ and RHS is undefined. This is an interface obstruction subject to the convention for argmin membership.
examples.zero_horizon_lawful: Both totals equal zero with an unused +∞ loss.

adjudication_order.decision: accepted locally in its frozen source-qualified scope
adjudication_order.decision_reason: Row 168 was adjudicated first. The previously accepted finite and restriction/coupling theorems supply the real telescoping calculation and the common admissible prefix. Combined with the domain and infinity results they cover the frozen parent, preserving its archival wording and stated repair.
adjudication_order.assumptions: Finite-dimensional real Euclidean space, nonempty closed feasible V ⊆ X, real regularizers on X, ambient losses taking values in (−∞,+∞], a comparator u ∈ X and supplied feasible minimizing choices through the terminal time.
adjudication_order.source_formula: F_t(v)=ψ_t(v)+Σ_{i<t}ℓ_i(v). Σ_{t=1}^T[ℓ_t(x_t)−ℓ_t(u)] = ψ_{T+1}(u)−min_{v∈V}ψ_1(v) + Σ_{t=1}^T[(F_t(x_t)−F_{t+1}(x_{t+1}))+ℓ_t(x_t)] + F_{T+1}(x_{T+1})−F_{T+1}(u), on the lawful source domain.
adjudication_order.representation: Code round 0 is source round 1. Code index T is the terminal objective and regularizer. The initial minimum is attained and represented by sInf. A source regularizer on X extends to the ambient space and the equality transfers back by restriction.
adjudication_order.independence: Keeping the regularizers equal on X for t<T preserves the admissible prefix. Given a terminal minimizer for the changed objective, one can reuse the actual prefix and change that final choice. Different selections from a tied argmin can differ.
adjudication_order.excluded: The archival statement remains available verbatim. The qualified identity retains the domain repair and does not assign an arithmetic value to an undefined expression. Generation of minimizers for a particular algorithm and terminal consumers 86 and 87 are separate obligations.
